daily.brief: 過去約30小時只有62則貼文、30個帳號，明顯比之前安靜。最清楚的共識是$AMD同$GOOGL被看好，而數據中心相關如$IREN則因為中期選舉結果被集中看淡。大盤$QQQ意見分裂最明顯。
daily.full:
共識

$AMD有2個帳號看好、0個看淡，7則相關貼文。@StockSavvyShay引用Lisa Su「我們現在預計2027年營收將增長超過80%」，比一年前長期目標高出一倍以上，數據中心預計佔明年總營收80%以上。原帖。@EliteOptions2則用76年中期選舉後12個月標普全勝的統計支持大盤同相關板塊。原帖。

$GOOGL同樣2個看好。@amitisinvesting指市場開始記起經濟不只半導體，像$GOOGL同$AMZN獲得關注，半導體拋售有點激進。原帖。@TheTranscript_則提到Waymo已超過3億英里完全自動駕駛，並在更多城市開放。原帖。

共同看淡

$IREN有2個帳號看淡。@LeopoldTracker_認為民主黨橫掃後有26名候選人主張關閉數據中心，這解釋了為何大盤漲1.5%但AI押注沒跟上。原帖。@michaelsikand指出德州州長候選人Hinojosa有80%機會勝出，而德州佔全美數據中心建設32%，對$IREN等雲/AI房東不利。原帖。

分歧

$QQQ是最多人講的，15則貼文，3個看好對3個看淡。@MrZackMorris覺得抓住了反轉，將取代furus。原帖。@EliteOptions2用中期選舉後歷史全勝統計支持反彈。但部分帳號仍擔心選舉前弱勢未完全釋放。

$SPY有11則，2看好對1看淡。@michaelsikand認為這像是AI恐懼高峯，資金輪動到價值股，投資者很快會因資本支出數字沒變而FOMO回場。原帖。但@RedDogT3不買入回調，認為整體只回落約4%，不足以啟動其「血洗街頭」策略。原帖。

其他值得留意

記憶體相關如$MU、$SNDK、$NBIS同樣被選舉同數據中心政策影響，出現分歧。大盤反彈同AI相關股受壓形成對比。

briefing.html:
今日重點

過去約30小時明顯安靜，只有62則貼文。最清楚的多頭聲音落在$AMD同$GOOGL身上，前者有Lisa Su對2027年營收增長超過80%的評論，後者則因市場開始關注半導體以外的公司。最大變化是中期選舉結果令數據中心政策風險浮現，$IREN等被集中看淡，有帳號指德州州長選情同關閉數據中心的候選人成為壓力。大盤$QQQ意見分裂，有人見反轉並引用選舉後歷史全勝統計，有人覺得回落幅度仍未夠。

daily.brief: About 30 hours with only 62 posts from 30 accounts, noticeably quieter. Clearest consensus is bullish on $AMD and $GOOGL, while data-center names like $IREN are clustered bearish after the midterm results. The biggest split is on $QQQ.
daily.full:
Consensus

$AMD had 2 bullish accounts and 0 bearish across 7 posts. @StockSavvyShay cited Lisa Su saying “we now expect revenue to grow more than 80% in 2027,” more than double the company’s long-term target from a year ago, with data centers expected to account for over 80% of next year’s total revenue. Post. @EliteOptions2 pointed to the 76-year perfect record of the S&P higher 12 months after every midterm. Post.

$GOOGL also had 2 bullish. @amitisinvesting said the market is remembering the economy is more than semiconductors, with names like $GOOGL and $AMZN getting attention and the semiconductor selloff looking aggressive. Post. @TheTranscript_ noted Waymo has driven over 300 million fully autonomous miles and is expanding to more cities. Post.

Shared bearish

$IREN had 2 bearish accounts. @LeopoldTracker_ argued the Democratic sweep and 26 candidates calling to shut down data centers explain why the broader market rose 1.5% but AI bets did not. Post. @michaelsikand noted Hinojosa has an 80% chance of becoming Texas governor (Texas is 32% of US data-center construction), which is negative for cloud/AI landlord stocks like $IREN. Post.

Splits

$QQQ was the most discussed with 15 posts, 3 bullish vs 3 bearish. @MrZackMorris said it caught the reversal and will replace furus. Post. @EliteOptions2 used the perfect midterm post-election history to support a bounce, while others still worry the pre-election weakness has not fully played out.

$SPY had 11 posts, 2 bullish vs 1 bearish. @michaelsikand sees this as peak AI fear, with money rotating to value and investors likely to FOMO back once they notice capex numbers have not changed. Post. @RedDogT3 is not buying the dip, saying the market is only about 4% off highs, not enough for his “blood in the streets” strategy. Post.

Other notes

Memory names such as $MU, $SNDK and $NBIS are also caught in the election and data-center policy discussion, creating splits. The market bounce versus pressure on AI-related names stands out.

briefing.html:
Today’s brief

The past ~30 hours were quiet with only 62 posts. The clearest bullish voices were on $AMD and $GOOGL—Lisa Su’s comment that 2027 revenue could grow more than 80%, and the market starting to notice names outside semiconductors. The biggest shift is the midterm outcome bringing data-center policy risk to the surface; $IREN and similar names are clustered bearish, with accounts citing the Texas governor race and candidates calling to shut data centers. Views on the broad market $QQQ are split: some see a reversal and cite the perfect post-midterm history, others say the pullback is still not deep enough.
